_comment: Behavioral kept-red proof for #1484. The real discoverTransCallSites enumerates a temporary routes fixture, readSourceFile deletes the target before the real read, and the named assertion requires the unfixed ENOENT to propagate. Corrected code fails this assertion with AssertionError. After auditing both drawer race windows and the translation race, no surviving mutation was found: (1) translation isEnoent => false makes the named translation test pass; (2) drawer stat-catch classification changed from isEnoent(error) to false makes the companion named drawer pre-stat test pass; (3) drawer read-catch classification changed from isEnoent(error) to false makes the companion named drawer post-stat test pass; (4) drawer isEnoent => false makes both companion named drawer tests pass.

expectedRed.testName: translation scanner propagates the unfixed ENOENT race
expectedRed.why: The exact reproducing path is discoverTransCallSites → real temporary routes enumeration → readSourceFile deletion → real read. The corrected ENOENT recovery makes the assertion fail; changing translation isEnoent to false or removing its read catch makes this named assertion pass, so the paired runner detects either restored bug.
